mainEntity.name: How much does a Peugeot 108 1.0 VTi engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Peugeot 108 1.0 VTi (1KR-FE) engine replacement typically costs £1,600-£1,900 for a rebuilt unit with supply and fit through a specialist. Used engines start from around £600-£1,000, while main dealer replacement can exceed £2,500.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of timing chain problems in a Peugeot 108 1.0 VTi?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common early warning sign is a rattling noise from the engine on cold start. As the problem worsens, you may notice loss of power, poor performance, and potential engine damage if left unaddressed.

mainEntity.name: Does the Peugeot 108 1.0 VTi have a timing belt or chain?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Peugeot 108 1.0 VTi uses a timing chain, not a rubber timing belt. The chain is designed for the life of the engine but can stretch or suffer guide wear over time, particularly without proper maintenance.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Peugeot 108 1.0 VTi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes - if the chassis and body are in good condition, a rebuilt 1KR-FE with upgraded components adds significant value and extends the vehicle's life. Given the vehicle's value (£2,500-£6,000), replacement cost should be evaluated against the car's condition.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Peugeot 108 1.0 VTi engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Peugeot 108 1.0 VTi engine replacement typically takes 2-4 days total. This includes 1-2 days for removal and fitting, plus additional time if the replacement engine requires preparation.

mainEntity.name: What oil should I use in my Peugeot 108 1.0 VTi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use 5W-30 fully synthetic engine oil meeting PSA B71 2290 specification. Mobil 1 ESP 5W-30 is one suitable option. Regular oil changes are essential for the 1KR-FE engine, particularly given its known oil consumption issues.

historyTimeline.h2: Peugeot 108 1.0 VTi - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The Peugeot 108 1.0 VTi is powered by the Toyota-derived 1KR-FE engine, a 1.0-litre three-cylinder petrol unit developed by Daihatsu (a Toyota subsidiary). Shared with the Citroën C1 and Toyota Aygo as part of the PSA-Toyota joint venture, this engine has been the entry-level petrol choice for the 108 since its 2014 launch.

milestones.description: 2021 - 72hp version considered more reliable than earlier 69hp units
Peugeot 108 production ends, replaced by electric-only 208 in some markets

commonProblems.h2: Peugeot 108 1.0 VTi Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Peugeot 108 1.0 VTi (1KR-FE) is generally a reliable engine when properly maintained, but early 69hp variants (2014-2018) have well-documented issues. Excessive oil consumption, timing chain wear, and clutch fragility are the most common problems driving replacement demand. The 72hp version (2018-2021) is a corrected, more reliable variant. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing the original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Excessive Oil Consumption - Why the Peugeot 108 1.0 VTi Wears Prematurely
problems.rootCause: The early 1KR-FE engine suffers from excessive oil consumption caused by worn piston rings or valve stem seals. Some examples can consume up to 1 litre of oil every 2,000 km. Regular oil level checks are essential - neglecting this exposes the engine to premature wear and costly failure.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Regular oil level checks and top-ups using correct 5W-30 oil
repairOptions.longevity: Essential preventative measure for all 1KR-FE engines

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: New piston rings, valve stem seals, head gasket
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught early and cylinder walls are not scored

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of rebuilt 1KR-FE with upgraded components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Recommended if oil consumption has caused significant internal damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Peugeot 108 1.0 VTi is worth approximately £2,500-£6,000 depending on mileage, condition, and specification. - Vehicle worth under ~£3,000: used engine typically makes more sense than a full rebuilt unit. - Vehicle worth ~£3,000-£4,500: evaluate both; reconditioned is viable if keeping the car 2+ years. - Vehicle worth £4,500+: reconditioned/rebuilt usually justifies the premium via warranty and reliability.
problems.recommendation: Regular oil checks are non-negotiable on the 1KR-FE. Use 5W-30 fully synthetic oil meeting PSA B71 2290 specification. If consumption exceeds 0.5L per 1,000 km, have the engine inspected. A top-end rebuild may be cost-effective if caught early, but a full replacement is often the more reliable long-term solution on high-mileage examples.

problems.h4: Timing Chain & Guide Failure - Common on Higher-Mileage 1KR-FE Engines
problems.rootCause: The 1KR-FE timing chain and guides can wear prematurely. Symptoms include a rattling noise from the engine, particularly on cold start. If left unaddressed, chain failure can cause catastrophic engine damage. Repairs are expensive as they involve major engine disassembly.

repairOptions.longevity: Best if caught early (rattle present, no engine damage). Specialist replacement typically £500-£800

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of rebuilt 1KR-FE with new timing components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Recommended if chain has failed and caused valvetrain or piston damage

problems.recommendation: If you hear a rattling noise from the Peugeot 108 1.0 VTi engine, have the timing chain inspected immediately. Replacement at the first sign of wear is far cheaper than a full engine rebuild - specialist timing chain replacement typically costs £500-£800. With proper servicing (regular oil changes every 10,000 miles), the chain should last longer.
